verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents first-party tool calling, letting models request application-defined functions (cerebras-docs-7). It also offers JSON-schema-constrained Structured Outputs and an OpenAI-compatible API (cerebras-docs-6, cerebras-docs-3), which support reliable integration with agent frameworks. The evidence never addresses parallel tool calls, multi-step loops, or tool-calling fidelity on open models, and there is no hands-on confirmation that agent loops run without breaking. missing for 10: documented parallel tool calling, documented multi-step/agentic tool-use behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of tool-call reliability on open models.
